title: Concepts Whisper: Spectral Anti-Concentration and the Dual Geometry of Transformer Representations
abstract: arXiv:2605.01609v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We find that transformer concept representations systematically anti-concentrate in the spectral tail of the unembedding covariance, encoding word-level concepts in low-variance directions across a 17-model core suite and an expanded set of 22 semantic concept categories, with convergent replications from three independent extraction methods. Residual-stream difference-of-means vectors anti-concentrate in all 17 models (model-level one-sample t-test, p = 3.8e-9), and remain more tail-aligned than norm-matched random directions in 13 of 17; convergent support comes from sparse autoencoder (SAE) features (p = 4.5e-19 across concepts within a model) and linear probes on Llama and Qwen. We identify a dual geometry: activation-space concept directions anti-concentrate while static unembedding-row contrasts concentrate in high-variance directions (p < 10^-4). translated_title: 概念低语：谱反集中性与Transformer表示的对偶几何
translated_abstract: 我们发现Transformer的概念表示在去嵌入协方差的谱尾部系统性地呈现反集中现象，将词级概念编码在低方差方向中。我们在17个模型的核心套件以及扩展至22个语义概念类别的数据集上进行了研究，并通过三种独立的提取方法获得了收敛一致的重复验证。残差流的均值差向量在全部17个模型中均表现出反集中性（模型级单样本t检验，p = 3.8e-9），且在17个模型中的13个里，其尾部对齐程度高于范数匹配的随机方向；稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征提供了收敛性支持（同一模型内跨概念p = 4.5e-19），在Llama和Qwen上的线性探针结果也印证了这一发现。我们识别出一种对偶几何结构：激活空间中的概念方向呈现反集中性，而静态的去嵌入行对比则集中于高方差方向（p < 10^-4）。本研究源于对……的因果内积是否……的测试（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: Transformer将词级概念系统性地编码在去嵌入协方差的低方差谱尾部方向（反集中），而静态去嵌入行对比却集中于高方差方向，由此揭示了Transformer表示的对偶几何结构。
en_tdlr: Transformer systematically encodes word-level concepts in low-variance spectral-tail directions of the unembedding covariance (anti-concentration), revealing a dual geometry in which activation-space concept directions anti-concentrate while static unembedding-row contrasts concentrate in high-variance directions.
